title: Optional Groundwater Response Sensitivity Service Extension

authority.contract: F-GC18 owns checkpoint, predictor-head request, trial response, optional response sensitivity, commit and rollback; F-GC23 consumes accepted provenance-matching SWAP sensitivity with groundwater-side response information

reconciliation.reason: The change extends the admitted external-groundwater service contract and therefore cannot be hidden inside F-GC23.

required_contract: optional additive response-sensitivity capability; existing groundwater providers remain source-compatible
response belongs to one existing groundwater trial candidate and its committed checkpoint origin
exact generic [t0,t1] window, service, lineage and revision provenance are transported and validated
unsupported, unavailable, nonsmooth, non-finite, stale or provenance-mismatched response fails closed
response query does not commit or alter committed groundwater state
no response is inferred from predictor/corrector secants
finite difference remains independent qualification/reference only
no concrete MODFLOW types or groundwater constitutive physics are introduced

compatibility_strategy.extension_form: additive opt-in subtype plus wrapper query

qualification_obligations: analytic deterministic response agrees with independent finite-difference reference on smooth structural fixtures
discarded or stale candidate cannot publish response
retry/discard path cannot leak response state
unsupported and nonsmooth providers return explicit unavailable/fail-closed result
response query leaves committed groundwater state unchanged
base F-GC18 and F-GC18R behavior preserved
next_permitted_action: Implement only the additive optional service response-sensitivity extension and owner qualification on this branch.
exclusions: structural finite difference as production response construction
F-GC23 implementation before F-GC29 canonical admission
